schema: retrospective log — what has been done. no planning, no future-dated entries. append only.

activity.subject: Iowa Survey Draft.xlsx ingested
activity.detail: Five curated sites with acreage, transmission and substation distances, wetland and FEMA notes, and two broker contacts.

activity.subject: CoStar Sites - IA.xlsx ingested
activity.detail: Three blocks: a six-row CoStar export with no acreage column, four LandWatch results, and three Land.com auction listings.
activity.outcome: Twelve further records created; one tract found duplicated across two sources.

activity.subject: USDA 2022 Census of Agriculture parsed — all 99 Iowa counties
activity.detail: Extracted farm counts, land in farms, average and median farm size, and the 500-999 and 1,000+ acre brackets directly from the county-level PDF tables.
activity.outcome: Median farm size by county became available, which is what makes owners-per-section computable.

activity.subject: County screen built and scored — 48 counties
activity.detail: Scored on landform region, assemblage difficulty, ordinance status and target-pool depth. Kossuth ranked first at 88.
activity.outcome: Target screen established. Public data layer complete.

activity.subject: Ordinance status researched
activity.detail: Nine Iowa counties confirmed with data-centre moratoria adopted during 2026; Taylor County recorded as having drafted an ordinance on 8 June 2026.
activity.outcome: Ordinance exposure identified on one pipeline site.

activity.subject: Contact universe compiled
activity.detail: Twenty-two organisations and people across utilities, regional development, state programmes, auction houses and courthouses, mapped to the counties and sites they cover.
activity.outcome: Execution layer established. No outreach initiated yet.

activity.subject: Public site deployed
activity.detail: Static site published to GitHub Pages, link-accessible without login and excluded from search indexing.

activity.subject: Iowa Land Brokerage — Matt Skinner
activity.detail: Good first call. Described the acreage requirement and flat-ground constraint.
activity.outcome: Surfaced a 640-acre off-market section at $12,000-12,500/ac where the owners have previously been willing to sell. Logged as S-018.

activity.subject: High Point Land Company — Trevor Glomski
activity.outcome: Nothing matching. Largest available was 107 acres near Davenport. Asked him to call back with any changes.

activity.subject: Iowa Farmland — website enquiry
activity.detail: Submitted the website contact form rather than calling.
activity.outcome: A 2,700+ acre figure noted against this firm. No location, parcel count or owner attached to it yet.

activity.subject: Whitacre Marketing Group — David Whitaker
activity.detail: Reached out regarding large contiguous acreage.

activity.subject: Flood review of the Section 16 prospect
activity.detail: Aerial map and three FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer panels reviewed for Sec 16, T92N R36W, Lincoln Township, Buena Vista County (42.782743, -95.100688).
activity.outcome: Zone A confirmed across much of the section, sourced from the North Raccoon River, with no Base Flood Elevation determined. Buildable area cannot be established without a hydraulic study.
